rci1_using_msad.detail: Single site (Washington University) but 4 Siemens MRI scanners at 2 field strengths: Magnetom Sonata, Avanto (1.5T, 42 scans), Biograph mMR, Magnetom Trio (3T, 2601 scans); meets multi-scanner criterion
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "All scans were acquired at two field strengths using Siemens MRI scanners: Magnetom Sonata and Avanto (1.5 T, 42 scans) as well as Biograph mMR and Magnetom Trio (both 3 T, 2′601 scans)."

rci2_using_epd.detail: OASIS3 (Open Access Series of Imaging Studies) used as the sole reference dataset for normative model building
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "we focussed the analysis on OASIS3 (Open Access Series of Imaging Studies; LaMontagne et al., 2019), a large and freely available dataset containing clinical grade high-resolution isotropic T1-weighted MRI scans"

rci3_epd_name.supporting_text: "The OASIS3 dataset (Open Access Series of Imaging Studies, LaMontagne et al., 2019) is publicly available at www.oasis-brains.org/"
